literal: Those who hate, saying, abandoning is there, O heart, we, if loved, those who do not love.
translation: O heart, is it possible to abandon him saying 'he hates us', when he does not return our love even as we love him?
modern: நெஞ்சே! நாம் அன்பு செலுத்தினாலும் நம்மிடம் அன்பு செலுத்தாத அவரை, அவர் நம்மை வெறுக்கிறார் என்று கூறி நாம் கைவிடுவது சாத்தியமா?
explanation: The heroine addresses her own heart, which is drawn to her lover despite his apparent indifference. She asks if it is truly possible to abandon him just because he seems to shun them. The contrast between 'யாம் உற்றால்' (when we love) and 'உறாஅதவர்' (he who does not love) highlights her unrequited yet unwavering affection. The rhetorical question 'கைவிடல் உண்டோ' implies that letting go is entirely impossible for her.
